title: Add ability to update product images and pricing

requirements.text: Create an AdminProductsPage component in frontend/src/pages/AdminProductsPage.tsx that displays all products in an editable table with columns for product image preview, name, variant, price (in INR), description, benefits, stock status, and action buttons to edit or delete each product

quotes: How can I change the pictures of the juice products in the website and also their pricing?

acceptanceCriteria: Table displays all products with their current data
Product images show as thumbnails in the table
Price is displayed in INR format (converted from cents stored in backend)
Edit and Delete buttons are present for each product row

requirements.text: Create a ProductEditModal component in frontend/src/components/ProductEditModal.tsx that allows editing product details including uploading a new product image, updating name, variant, price (in INR), description, benefits array, and stock status

quotes: How can I change the pictures of the juice products in the website and also their pricing?

acceptanceCriteria: Modal opens when edit button is clicked on a product
Form fields are pre-populated with existing product data
Image upload field allows selecting a new product image file
Price input accepts INR values and converts to cents for backend storage
Benefits can be added or removed as list items
Save button submits changes to backend

requirements.text: Implement backend function updateProduct(productId: Text, name: Text, variant: Text, price: Nat, description: Text, benefits: [Text], imageUrl: Text, inStock: Bool) that updates the product data in the stable storage and returns a success boolean

quotes: How can I change the pictures of the juice products in the website and also their pricing?

acceptanceCriteria: Function locates product by productId in stable storage
All provided fields are updated for the product
Updated product data persists across canister upgrades
Returns true on success, false if product not found

requirements.text: Implement backend function deleteProduct(productId: Text) that removes a product from stable storage and returns a success boolean
acceptanceCriteria: Function removes product from stable storage
Returns true on successful deletion, false if product not found
Deleted products no longer appear in getProducts() results

requirements.text: Create React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for useUpdateProduct (mutation to update product data) and useDeleteProduct (mutation to delete a product), both invalidating the products query on success
acceptanceCriteria: useUpdateProduct accepts product data and calls backend updateProduct function
useDeleteProduct accepts productId and calls backend deleteProduct function
Both hooks invalidate the products query cache on successful mutation
Product list refreshes automatically after update or delete

requirements.text: Add route for admin products page at /admin/products in App.tsx and add a navigation link to access it from the Navigation component alongside the existing admin dashboard link
acceptanceCriteria: Admin products page is accessible at /admin/products route
Navigation component includes link to admin products page
Link is visible in the same section as the admin dashboard link

requirements.text: Handle product image uploads by accepting image files in the ProductEditModal, converting them to data URLs or uploading to frontend/public/assets/products/ directory, and updating the product's imageUrl field with the new image path

quotes: How can I change the pictures of the juice products in the website and also their pricing?

acceptanceCriteria: Image file input accepts common image formats (PNG, JPG, WEBP)
Selected image is displayed as preview in the modal
Image is saved to frontend/public/assets/products/ with a unique filename
Product's imageUrl is updated to reference the new image path
New product image displays correctly on ProductCard after save

constraints: Maintain the existing single-actor backend architecture in backend/main.mo

Do not modify the read-only paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Price must be stored in cents (Nat) in the backend but displayed and edited in INR format in the frontend
nonGoals: Adding authentication or authorization to the admin pages
Product inventory management beyond stock status
Image editing or cropping capabilities within the modal
